problems.title: HP printer keeps showing 'Offline' on Windows 11
problems.body: My HP network printer works for a while, then Windows shows it as 'Offline' and print jobs sit in the queue.

solutions.body: The printer's IP address changes. Create a DHCP reservation for the printer on the router, then remove and re-add the printer in Windows.
Run HP Smart's 'Diagnose & Fix' or HP Print and Scan Doctor.

problems.title: Operation failed with error 0x0000011b when connecting to shared printer
problems.body: Connecting to a printer shared from another Windows PC fails: 'Windows cannot connect to the printer. Operation failed with error 0x0000011b'.

solutions.body: On the PC sharing the printer, add the registry value HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Print RpcAuthnLevelPrivacyEnabled (DWORD) = 0 and restart the spooler.
solutions.code:
reg add "HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Print" /v RpcAuthnLevelPrivacyEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
net stop spooler && net start spooler

solutions.body: Add the printer directly by IP (Add printer > 'Add a printer using an IP address or hostname') instead of through the shared connection.

problems.title: Canon PIXMA support code 1688 (ink has run out)
problems.body: My Canon PIXMA shows 'Support Code 1688 – The ink has run out' right after I refilled the cartridge.

solutions.body: Press and hold the Stop button for 5-10 seconds to continue printing with ink level detection disabled for that cartridge.

problems.title: Print Spooler keeps stopping, print jobs stuck in queue
problems.body: Print jobs stay stuck in the queue and can't be deleted; the Print Spooler service stops on its own.

solutions.body: Stop the spooler, delete the stuck spool files, and start it again (elevated Command Prompt).
solutions.code:
net stop spooler
del /Q /F %systemroot%\System32\spool\PRINTERS\*
net start spooler

problems.title: Samsung TV shows no signal / no 4K120 from PS5 over HDMI
problems.body: My PS5 shows a black screen or can't select 4K 120Hz on my Samsung TV.

solutions.body: Enable Input Signal Plus for the HDMI port: Settings > General > External Device Manager > Input Signal Plus > turn on for the PS5's HDMI input, and use the TV's HDMI 2.1 port with the PS5's included cable.

problems.title: Fire TV Stick remote not responding
problems.body: My Fire TV Stick remote stopped working even with new batteries.

solutions.body: Reset and re-pair the remote.
steps: Hold Left, Menu, and Back together for 12 seconds, release, and wait 5 seconds
Remove the batteries and unplug the Fire TV for 60 seconds
Reinsert batteries, plug the Fire TV back in, and press Home on the remote once the home screen loads

problems.title: Roku shows 'HDCP error detected'
problems.body: My Roku shows a purple screen with 'HDCP error detected' on my TV.

solutions.body: Connect the Roku directly to the TV (no HDMI switch or receiver), try a different HDMI port and cable, and power-cycle the TV and Roku.

problems.title: Soundbar audio out of sync with TV picture over HDMI ARC
problems.body: Speech from my soundbar lags behind lip movement when connected via HDMI ARC.

solutions.body: Set the TV's digital audio output to Passthrough/Auto, enable eARC if available, and adjust the TV's AV sync / audio delay setting.

problems.title: Nintendo Switch Joy-Con drift
problems.body: My left Joy-Con's character keeps moving even when I'm not touching the stick.

solutions.body: Recalibrate the stick: System Settings > Controllers and Sensors > Calibrate Control Sticks.
Replace the analog stick module or send the Joy-Con to Nintendo for repair; drift is usually wear of the stick sensor.

problems.title: PS5 DualSense controller won't connect
problems.body: My DualSense controller just blinks and won't connect to the PS5.

solutions.body: Reset the controller with a pin in the small hole on the back (hold 5 seconds), then connect it to the PS5 with a USB cable and press the PS button.

problems.title: Ring Video Doorbell keeps going offline
problems.body: My Ring doorbell disconnects from Wi-Fi several times a day.

solutions.body: Check signal strength in the Ring app (Device Health > Signal Strength / RSSI). If it's weak, add a Ring Chime Pro or mesh node closer to the door.
Reconnect it in the Ring app: Device Health > Change Wi-Fi Network, choosing a 2.4 GHz network.

problems.title: Philips Hue lights show as 'Unreachable'
problems.body: Some of my Hue bulbs show 'Unreachable' in the Hue app.

solutions.body: Make sure the wall switch for those bulbs stays on; a switched-off fixture cuts power to the bulb. Use a smart switch or switch cover if needed.
Change the Hue Bridge's Zigbee channel (Settings > Bridge > Zigbee channel change) to avoid Wi-Fi interference.

problems.title: Kindle frozen on a page or stuck on boot screen
problems.body: My Kindle is frozen and won't respond to taps or the power button.

solutions.body: Hold the power button for 40 seconds (or until the device restarts), then release.

problems.title: Apple Watch won't pair with new iPhone
problems.body: Setting up my Apple Watch with a new iPhone gets stuck at 'Pairing' or fails with 'Unable to pair'.

solutions.body: Update the iPhone to the latest iOS, then erase the watch (Settings > General > Reset > Erase All Content and Settings) and pair again.

problems.title: Smart TV apps keep crashing or say not enough memory
problems.body: Apps on my LG TV close on their own and show 'This app will now restart to free up more memory'.

solutions.body: Turn off Quick Start+ (Settings > General > Devices > TV Management or Additional Settings) so the TV fully restarts when powered off, clearing memory.
